methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Blitzpanel is a pre-seed stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Caleb Ho. The valuation universe consists of ten peers in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector—one public company (277810.KQ) and nine private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. However, the peer set exhibits structural limitations for traditional comparable company analysis.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. While ten same-sector peers exist, filtering by stage specificity and valuation tier yields fewer than three datapoints—the minimum threshold for reliable median-based triangulation. No pre-seed robotics companies appear in the available comp universe, and the adjacent-stage peer set contains only one company. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity in robotics company maturity, technology focus, and capital intensity across stages.

The analysis therefore cannot produce a triangulated valuation range based on the current data. A defensible valuation for Blitzpanel would require either: (1) expansion of the pre-seed robotics peer set to at least three comparables, (2) application of alternative methods such as discounted cash flow or venture capital method calibration, or (3) explicit use of stage-adjusted multiples from the broader private robotics universe. The current dataset supports stage and sector positioning but does not support quantitative valuation synthesis.
